name: clips/t1_walk_flood
prompt: First-person POV handheld walk along the stone river embankment at night in heavy rain. The camera walks forward steadily with a gentle natural bob, the dark hood edge at the top of frame and the white earbud cable swinging slightly. Ahead the path is flooded; the camera keeps walking into the shallow water, ripples spreading, rain hitting the surface, sodium streetlight reflections shimmering. Then a single distant flash of lightning briefly lights the whole scene. Realistic, cinematic, 35mm film look, no people visible, no text.
